AST of docker0_client.py has no LOCK_EX attribute. inspect_gpu0_lock uses /proc/locks and a shared non-blocking flock only; lock_ex_taken_by_client is false on the live probe, the healthy generate path, and the child-held exclusive flock fixture. criteria.criterion: IPFS_ACCELERATE_LLAMA_CPP_AUTOSTART=0; never start a second llama-server.
criteria.explanation: pin_client_env sets IPFS_ACCELERATE_LLAMA_CPP_AUTOSTART=0 (and AUTO_INSTALL/PREFETCH/AUTO_UPDATE=0) before any probe or generate. Self-check recorded autostart=0 during the healthy generate path and llama_server_started=false. AST audit of subprocess calls found no llama-server / ipfs-accelerate-llama-cpp-serve argv. Optional owner exec targets scripts/run_leanstral_ephemeral.py --bind docker0 --gpu 0; that child would own the server. This process did not start llama-server.

criteria.criterion: If unhealthy and gpu-0.lock free, may exec run_leanstral_ephemeral.py --bind docker0 --gpu 0; if EX held, wait or skip LLM.
criteria.explanation: decide_action is generate when /health is ok; exec_owner only when unhealthy, gpu-0.lock free, and allow_owner_exec; skip_llm when exclusive ownership is held and wait_seconds=0; wait when exclusive ownership is held and wait_seconds>0. Self-check spawned a child that took exclusive flock on a temp gpu-0.lock; the client detected held=true via /proc/locks, took no exclusive lock itself, and chose skip_llm. A stub owner script (not llama-server) was executed with --bind docker0 --gpu 0. Live plan_session did not exec the owner because /health was already ok. scripts/run_leanstral_ephemeral.py is absent in this worktree; the argv is still recorded.
